title: Ksmashhero06/autonomous-vibe-newsletter-engine
summary: 该项目是一个完全免费的、多代理自主内容和技术新闻通讯管道，使用本地Python框架和Gemini API通过Google AI Studio构建。该项目是一个为期5天的渐进式项目，与Kaggle Vibe编码密集型项目的架构里程碑相对应。
description: A 100% free, multi-agent autonomous content and technical newsletter pipeline built entirely using local Python frameworks and the Gemini API via Google AI Studio. Developed as a 5-day progressive project mapping to the architectural milestones of the Kaggle Vibe Coding Intensive.
